headline: 3 Stocks Riding The AI Data Center And Power Buildout
summary: AI is no longer just a tech story. It pulls in chipmakers, data center operators, and power suppliers, all racing to support massive training runs and always-on models while the Federal Reserve watches for AI-fueled inflation. That mix of heavy spending and tighter policy can reward some stocks and leave others behind. This piece unpacks the trend and walks through 3 stocks exposed to that news shift. The stocks covered below are only a small sample of what screens well for this AI build out...
